subject: JAX-MPC kickoff — a standard control stack for sim benchmarks
body: Team — kickoff for the JAX-MPC work in agents-rl. Base: our JAX Particles release — model-predictive controllers in JAX, where monte-carlo-style MPC gets cheap because rollouts parallelize under jax.vmap. The MPPI implementation is the starting point: the released interface (init_state / update / get_action against any env exposing step and reward) with the reference config at 5 iterations × 16 steps × 16 samples. Product angle: a standard control stack for our sim-benchmark environments, so agents-rl teams stop writing bespoke planners. Milestones: interface hardening plus baselines across three internal sim envs by mid-May; a scaling study (how far vmap takes sample counts on real accelerators) by mid-June; adopt/park decision end of June. Deshawn owns staffing; resourcing and the compute-budget conversation follow once Finance settles the Q3 lines. — Ulla
